# BoltProof — IT On Your Terms
> IT help on your terms. Corporate tech by day; by choice I help people — friends, family, and strangers — with the technology in their lives. Laptops, phones, Wi-Fi, printers, passwords, 2FA, scams, network hardening, and AI. You pay what you feel it's worth, from coffee money to nothing at all. No contracts, no meter, no obligation, no spam.

## What I help with
- **Everyday IT** — laptops, phones, Wi-Fi, printers, backups; diagnosed, not guessed
- **Cyber security** — passwords, 2FA, spotting and stopping scams, home and small-business hardening, and a clear plan if something's already gone wrong
- **AI** — which tools are actually worth your time, real use out of them, and what not to trust them with

## How it works
1. Tell me what's going on — a sentence, a photo, or a voice note is enough
2. I help — a call, a screen-share, or a written walkthrough; most small things get sorted in one go
3. You pay what you feel — no retainer, no subscription, no fine print
